differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are significantly darker than the center, showing a strong vignette.
differences.b_observable: The frame is evenly lit from center to corners with no visible vignette.
differences.fix: Introduce a vignette effect to darken the corners of the frame.

differences.a_observable: The shadows in the crevices between the tiles are deep and dark, creating high contrast.
differences.b_observable: The crevices are brightly lit with very shallow shadows, making the scene look flat.
differences.fix: Increase ambient occlusion or darken the shadow tones in the crevices between tiles.

differences.a_observable: The yellow Recurly tile has a warm, highly saturated golden hue.
differences.b_observable: The yellow tile has a cooler, less saturated pale yellow hue.
differences.fix: Adjust the color temperature and saturation of the yellow material to match the warm golden tone.

differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned at a low angle, causing the tiles to tilt away with strong perspective.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned at a higher, more top-down angle, resulting in less perspective tilt.
differences.fix: Lower the camera height and tilt it up to match the reference's perspective.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera angle and focal length to match the lower, more dynamic perspective of the reference video, and deepen the shadows between the keyboard keys to improve contrast.
